title: Why is there so much international interest in Greenland?
summary: The BBC's Europe Editor Katya Adler has been reporting from Greenland and dissects why the island has so much value in the eyes of President Trump.

title: F.A.A. Urges ‘Caution’ Over Oceans in Latin America, Warning of Military Activity

title: Starlink Users in Iran Get Free Internet Access, Nonprofits Say
summary: Under a near-total communications blackout, users of Elon Musk’s satellite service have gotten online without paying, organizations that work on tech issues said.
